summaries.plain:
CSV export now explicitly uses UTF-8, with regression coverage for accented and Japanese text. Raw output was verified; Ruff, whitespace checks, and the full suite pass with 186 tests and 3 skipped.

Payroll March 2025 version 3 was approved by `finance.ops`; four acknowledged exceptions had no blockers. Disbursement batch `batch-20250328-1842` queued 248 payments totaling **$986,442.17**. The bank payment still needs execution, followed by employee notification.

For **LEDGERLY-4248**, billing typing is largely complete. `LineItem`, invoice-line generation, total calculation, and `post_entry` are annotated. Generator and Decimal return issues were fixed, and `post_entry` uses timezone-aware `datetime.now(timezone.utc)`. All 34 billing tests pass without the prior warning; mypy and whitespace checks pass. Broader runs passed 96 tests and another baseline 318 with 4 skipped.

An unresolved invoice ordering bug remains: `apply_credit` adds the credit memo before deducting the refund, causing `test_apply_credit_after_refund` to return **$90.00** instead of **$87.50**.

Invoice tests were refactored with a reusable `make_invoice`, transactional `db_session` fixture, and `organization_factory`, removing 19 duplicated setup blocks. All 46 invoice tests pass. Profiling showed database setup took 18.7 seconds and three tests each exceeded one second due to independent payment-history loads. A module-scoped `customer_batch` fixture now creates and persists ten customers once; all dependent tests pass.

Search optimization still needs `bulk_upsert` integration, correction of the remaining tenant migration helper, and targeted/full tests plus Ruff and `git diff --check`. Separately, change the CI matrix-job threshold from **more than 6** to **more than 12**.
summaries.structured:

Payroll `payroll-2025-03` is at version 3, approved by `finance.ops`. Disbursement batch `batch-20250328-1842` was created and submitted, queuing 248 payments totaling $986,442.17. Remaining stages are batch approval, execution submission, and employee notification.

Billing typing replaced deprecated UTC timestamps with timezone-aware `datetime.now(timezone.utc)`.
